info.title: Ichnora public data
info.description: Daily crypto calls, market light, track record and Rebound Radar as static JSON files. No key, no rate limit beyond normal web hosting. Updated once a day around 11:30 UTC. Research data from a public experiment, not financial advice. Crypto is volatile and can go to zero. Past results do not guarantee future returns. Use as one input next to your own judgement and risk limits.
